## Service Specifications & FAQs

### Web Application Development (https://deep5devlopers.github.io/services/web-development/)
Deep5 Tech engineers fast, secure web portals and SaaS platforms built to handle high traffic on mobile networks.
- Customer & Dealer B2B Portals: We build self-service dealer ordering portals that sync live inventory, GST pricing slabs, and dispatch receipts automatically.
- Internal Multi-Tenant SaaS Systems: Your team manages tenant roles, subscription limits, audit trails, and automated billing from a clean browser workspace.
- High-Speed REST & Webhook APIs: We connect payment gateways, Tally accounting ledgers, SMS alerts, and shipping couriers with predictable latency.
- Mobile-First Progressive Web Apps: Field managers load order screens in under two seconds on budget Android phones over standard 4G connections.
- Q: How long does a custom web application take in Rajkot? A: Most B2B customer portals ship in four to six weeks with weekly staging demos.
- Q: Will we own the complete web source code? A: Yes. Deep5 Tech transfers full repository ownership and cloud credentials upon launch.
- Q: Can our web portal integrate with Tally or busy accounting tools? A: Yes. We build scheduled bridges and API webhooks that keep GST invoices synchronized.
- Q: Do you optimize web applications for slow Android mobile connections? A: Yes. Every screen targets strict Core Web Vitals and compact HTML payloads by default.

- Field Visit & Dealer Tracking: Track territory check-ins, sample dispatches, and distributor credit balances across Gujarat sales zones cleanly.
- Role-Based Pipeline Analytics: Sales heads view real conversion ratios, lost-deal reasons, and monthly revenue forecasts without manual Excel merges.
- Q: Can a custom CRM import leads from IndiaMART and WhatsApp automatically? A: Yes. Webhooks pull incoming buyer leads instantly and assign them by territory or product line.
- Q: How is a custom CRM better than Zoho or HubSpot for Rajkot SMEs? A: You avoid rising per-user dollar fees and get exact quotation, GST, and dispatch tracking.
- Q: Can we migrate ten years of Excel customer sheets safely? A: Yes. Our onboarding script deduplicates phone numbers and imports complete contact history cleanly.
- Q: Does the CRM work on mobile phones for outside sales reps? A: Yes. Every screen works cleanly in mobile browsers with one-tap WhatsApp and call logging.

### HRMS & Payroll (https://deep5devlopers.github.io/services/hrms-software/)
Deep5 Tech automates biometric attendance syncing, shift overtime math, PF/ESIC deductions, and one-click payslips for industrial teams.
- Biometric & Face-Scan Sync: Pull raw punch logs from eSSL, Matrix, and Hikvision devices every five minutes across multiple plant gates.
- Shift & Overtime Calculation Engine: Handle day/night shifts, grace windows, piece-rate incentives, and contractor hours with zero manual tallying.
- Indian Statutory Payroll Automation: Calculate PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS, and salary advances accurately in one monthly run.
- Employee Self-Service Portal: Workers view shift rosters, apply for leave, and download salary slips directly on mobile phones.
- Q: Does your HRMS pull punches automatically from eSSL biometric devices? A: Yes. We connect directly over local network push or cloud relay APIs.
- Q: Can the payroll module track employee loans and mid-month advances? A: Yes. Advance ledgers deduct approved EMIs automatically inside each monthly salary run.
- Q: How do factory supervisors fix missed punch records? A: Supervisors review flagged exceptions in one screen with full audit logs for HR approval.
- Q: Can payslips export bank NEFT bulk upload files? A: Yes. Generate formatted bank transfer sheets and individual PDF slips in one click.

### Factory Data Management (https://deep5devlopers.github.io/services/factory-data-management/)
Deep5 Tech replaces paper job cards with real-time CNC output tracking, rejection analysis, and heat-number batch traceability.
- Digital Job Cards & Batch Routing: Track raw bar or casting batches across cutting, machining, heat treatment, grinding, and final packing stages.
- Machine Output & Downtime Logs: Operators log idle time reasons and tool changes in two taps so bottlenecks show clearly.
- Quality Inspection & Rejection Control: Record dimensional tolerance checks, rejection codes, and rework counts by operator, die, and shift.
- Consumable & Scrap Reconciliation: Compare issued brass, steel, or polymer weight against finished part weight and recoverable scrap.
- Q: Will machine operators need fast typing skills to log entries? A: No. Simple tap selectors, batch dropdowns, and QR job-card scans keep logging under ten seconds.
- Q: Can it work if plant Wi-Fi drops temporarily? A: Yes. Screens queue local submissions cleanly and sync automatically once signal returns.
- Q: Can we trace a customer complaint back to the raw material batch? A: Yes. Full lot genealogy links final boxes back to heat numbers, machines, and QC inspectors.
- Q: Does this integrate with our existing ERP or HRMS? A: Yes. We connect attendance shifts and stock ledgers directly over secure APIs.

### Warehouse Management (https://deep5devlopers.github.io/services/warehouse-management/)
Deep5 Tech delivers custom WMS software that tracks bin locations, QR/barcode picking, FIFO expiry, and mistake-free truck dispatches.
- Rack, Bin & Zone Mapping: Assign every pallet and carton a verified aisle-rack-bin address so new pickers find items fast.
- Barcode & QR Putaway and Picking: Verify inbound GRNs, generate thermal pallet labels, and enforce FIFO pick paths using handheld scanners.
- Multi-Godown Stock Transfers: Monitor inventory in transit across Rajkot godowns, Morbi depots, and customer consignment warehouses cleanly.
- Dispatch Verification & E-Way Prep: Scan boxes onto loading bays to stop short shipments and export clean packing lists immediately.
- Q: Do we need expensive proprietary barcode hardware to run this WMS? A: No. Standard USB/Bluetooth scanners and regular Android phones scan labels accurately.
- Q: Can the system manage inventory across multiple warehouses? A: Yes. View stock per godown, reserved dispatch orders, and inter-branch transfers in one dashboard.
- Q: Does your WMS handle batch FIFO and shelf-life tracking? A: Yes. Picklists highlight oldest valid batches automatically to prevent dead stock buildup.
- Q: Can we export packing slips and low-stock reorder lists to Excel? A: Yes. Every stock movement ledger exports cleanly to CSV, Excel, and print PDFs.

- Q: Will your AI system share our private company files with public models? A: No. We use zero-retention enterprise APIs or isolated private deployments for strict data privacy.
- Q: How accurate is AI invoice and purchase order extraction? A: Structured validation combined with confidence flags achieves high accuracy while letting humans verify edge cases.
- Q: Can AI work with Gujarati or Hindi scanned supplier documents? A: Yes. Modern multimodal extraction reads clean printed multi-language invoices accurately.
- Q: How do you keep monthly AI API bills predictable? A: We enforce caching, compact prompts, smaller routing models, and strict per-user token limits.
